name: Violet
source:
Witch class.
Violet has an especially strong sense of pride and an obsession with becoming the best at everything.
When she becomes too focused on her goals, she loses sight of her surroundings and fails to achieve the desired results.
Violet highly respects her father, a politician who looks down on ordinary people—especially humans. Because she was raised with those beliefs, she considers the human class students unworthy of her grace.
